input.command:
hs -c 'local function sig()
    local parts = {}
    pcall(function()
        local app = hs.application.frontmostApplication()
        parts[#parts+1] = app and (app:bundleID() or app:name() or "?") or "?"
        parts[#parts+1] = app and tostring(app:pid()) or "?"
        local win = hs.window.focusedWindow()
        parts[#parts+1] = win and tostring(win:id()) or "-"
        parts[#parts+1] = (win and win:title()) or ""
        local ae = app and hs.axuielement.applicationElement(app)
        local elem = ae and ae:attributeValue("AXFocusedUIElement")
        if elem then
            for _, a in ipairs({"AXRole","AXSubrole","AXIdentifier","AXDOMIdentifier","AXTitle"}) do
                local v = elem:attributeValue(a)
                parts[#parts+1] = (type(v)=="string") and v or ""
            end
        end
    end)
    return table.concat(parts, "|")
end
local worst, total = 0, 0
for i = 1, 10 do
  local t = hs.timer.absoluteTime(); sig(); local d = (hs.timer.absoluteTime()-t)/1e6
  total = total + d; if d > worst then worst = d end
end
return string.format("warm: avg %.1f ms, worst %.1f ms", total/10, worst)' 2>&1 | tail -1
input.description: Measure warm cost of the signature
